<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="barrows-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Barrows Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/zxLswr2B8q.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Barrows Brothers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1" alt="dharokhead" title="dharokhead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> were originally composed of six wights, two more members were added after completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ritual_of_the_Mahjarrat <nowiki>Ritual of the Mahjarrat</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kindred_Spirits <nowiki>Kindred Spirits</nowiki>]<nowiki> quests.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This guides aims to get you started on doing Barrows runs, and will focus on the original six brothers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It will be assumed that you're using Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the entry-level preset.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ War's Retreat is used for easy access to the Barrows Brothers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1" alt="dharokhead" title="dharokhead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• War's Retreat Teleport </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1" alt="warsretreatteleport" title="warsretreatteleport" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is unlocked via getting 10 boss kills (any boss).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using High Contrast Mode lets you see which door is clickable when in the tunnels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click the World Map to toggle it on.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Nu2xIB4Lkofr2T9XkjOu <nowiki>Magic - Mid-level</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/5c5dff9189cbe010acbe128d1f0c1c220754f9c02c603def5aeca3f589c260d8.webp" alt="Ghost hunter" kind="addition" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=K7fbsgueiX8Z1w9smbiN <nowiki>Magic - Entry-level</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FK7fbsgueiX8Z1w9smbiN.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The mid-level preset and example video can be used as a reference if you're interested in killing Akrisae and Linza.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-unlocks"><nowiki>Useful Unlocks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>


</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The following allow you to increase the efficiency of your runs:
    • Although useful, they are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> mandatory.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Salve amulet (e)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment <nowiki>Ghost hunter equipment</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterhelm" title="ghosthunterhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerburst_of_acceleration#(4) <nowiki>Powerburst of acceleration</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Surge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Dive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will increase the speed of your runs.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Luck <nowiki>Luck enhancers</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717295935500.png?v=1" alt="luckpotion" title="luckpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases chances at barrows equipment </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507658267164672.png?v=1" alt="dharokbody" title="dharokbody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and amulet of the forsaken </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893934334012.png?v=1" alt="amuletoftheforesaken" title="amuletoftheforesaken" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • You only need tier 2 luck.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>The Brothers</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ As this is an older encounter, there aren't many mechanics to be wary of.
    • Each brother has a mechanic, which can mostly be ignored.
        ⬩ Dharok increases his damage dealt, the lower his life points get.
    • Being underground will periodically drain your prayer points.
    • The catacombs are a maze, with a simple puzzle at the end.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>The Catacombs</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Searching one of the sarcophagi will place you in a random corner of the catacombs.
    • This sarcophagus is random, and normally reserved for last.
⬥ The catacombs are composed of a series of tunnels, in the shape of a 3x3 grid, with a treasure room in the center.
    • The path to the center is randomly generated.
    • Using High Contrast Mode makes finding the correct path easier.
⬥ The door leading to the center of the catacombs will have one of four, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Barrows_Brothers/Strategies#The_tunnels <nowiki>simple puzzles</nowiki>]<nowiki>, which always have the same solution.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-fight"><ins><nowiki>The Fight</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="order-the-brothers-should-be-killed"><nowiki>Order the Brothers Should be Killed</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Dharok → Ahrim → Karil → Guthan → Torag → Verac</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can use protection prayers to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Dharok, Guthan, Torag, and Verac.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommagic" title="protectfrommagic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Ahrim.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommissiles" title="protectfrommissiles" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Karil.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Try to make good use of Surge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Dive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotations"><ins><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373972443775056.png?v=1" alt="sonicwave" title="sonicwave" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improv</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternate starts between Wild Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
